agents.name: robot_planner
agents.description: Turns a plain-language robot idea into a structured specification: platform, drivetrain, power source, requirements, and constraints.

agents.name: component_research
agents.description: Selects a compatible bill of materials for the robot archetype, including controllers, drivers, motors, sensors, and power.

agents.name: electrical_engineering
agents.description: Creates a full pinout, nets, power budgets, and wiring steps, then validates voltage, logic-level, grounding, current, and pin conflicts.

agents.name: programming
agents.description: Generates pin-mapped, multi-file firmware scaffolds for every selected language, with the controller's real pin assignments.

agents.name: mechanical_design
agents.description: Generates a basic parametric chassis STL, estimates printed weight, and prices it with the JOD material chart.

agents.name: cost_estimation
agents.description: Rolls up the bill of materials and 3D-print material into a transparent estimate in USD and JOD, with budget alternatives.
